title: Dead by Daylight
shortDescription: Dead by Daylight is included in GameAtlas's Nintendo Switch horror and survival route, alongside deterministic catalog context and a linked Wikidata item.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced horror and survival option to the Nintendo Switch discovery path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Registered for the Nintendo Switch horror and survival discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
